description: This file defines an internal utility for managing asynchronous enumerables, including classes for publishing, enumerating, and handling state changes in async streams within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: AsyncEnumerable<T>
classes.description: A thread-safe, publish-subscribe asynchronous enumerable supporting value updates and iteration.

classes.name: AsyncEnumerable<T>.AsyncEnumerator
classes.description: An asynchronous enumerator for iterating over the async enumerable.

classes.name: AsyncEnumerable<T>.Element
classes.description: Represents a node in the async enumerable stream, with state management for validity, disposal, and linked list of elements.

methods.name: AsyncEnumerable<T>.TryPublish
methods.description: Attempts to publish a new value wrapped in an Element; returns success or failure.

methods.name: AsyncEnumerable<T>.Publish
methods.description: Publishes a new value, throwing exceptions if invalid or disposed.

methods.name: AsyncEnumerable<T>.TryPublish<TState>
methods.description: Attempts to publish an update based on a update function and state.

methods.name: AsyncEnumerable<T>.Publish<TState>
methods.description: Publishes an update based on a update function and state, throwing exceptions if invalid or disposed.

methods.name: AsyncEnumerable<T>.Dispose
methods.description: Disposes the current element, marking it as disposed.

methods.name: AsyncEnumerable<T>.GetAsyncEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an async enumerator for the sequence.

methods.name: AsyncEnumerable<T>.AsyncEnumerator.MoveNextAsync
methods.description: Moves to the next element asynchronously, returning false if disposed.

methods.name: AsyncEnumerable<T>.Element.SetNext
methods.description: Sets the next element in the sequence.
